messages:
Maya: Quick status check on telemetry for token-cost/latency — can we get owners, blockers, and any gated deps? Trying to lock milestones for next O-week.

Aj: Owners: Aj -> ingest/transform pipeline, Sanjay -> event schema, Elaine -> cost attribution logic + metric reports. Lucy/Leo -> infra & backfills. ETA for first pass (schema + ingest) = EOW if no blockers.

Sanjay: Posted schema PR: https://git.redwood/instrumentation/pr/712 (rename `tokens` -> `model_tokens`, add `seq_len`). Main blocker: compatibility with legacy embeddings event. Proposed shim in ingest for 2 weeks.

Elaine: I have baseline costing numbers for current day rate. Need sample events with `model_tokens` and `response_ms` fields to validate rollup. Also question about whether we should surface quantized vs float token counts — prefer raw token count, we can tag quantized runs with `quant_profile`.

Aj: Canary plan: route 1% of traffic to `instr-canary` dataset first, validate token attribution and cost match, then ramp 1% -> 5% -> 20%. Config snippet:
```yaml
canary_dataset: instr-canary
initial_sample_rate: 0.01
ramp: [0.05, 0.2]
verification_checks: [token_sum_match, latency_hist_stable]
```

Lucy: Data infra note — upstream mapping PR for `model_name` canonicalization is still open (blocked on ops-review). Backfill for 30 days will take ~6h; prefer Fri 02:00 PT low-traffic window.

Leo: On SRE side — latency histogram ingestion will add ~40% to write QPS for the metrics topic. Need to throttle histograms (bucketed) or move to separate topic. If we keep same topic we need capacity bump before canary 20% ramp.

product-ana: Can we make sure `account_id` or `customer_tier` is available in the telemetry? Product needs per-tier cost breakdown for next review. If PII concerns, hashed account id is fine.

Sanjay: We can add `account_id_hash` in schema; will not send raw IDs. Update in PR 712. Also adding `customer_tier` enum optional.

Elaine: Ping on CR #458 (cost calc changes) — blocked by a small edge-case in `partial_tokens` handling. @Aj can you take a look today?

Aj: On it, I will push a fix and run unit tests by EOD. If green I'll merge and kick off canary.

infra-bot: deploy/instr-canary started by Aj at 2026-03-17T18:35:12Z — stage=deploying, target=instr-canary.

Maya: Thanks. Action items I have captured: 1) Aj fix CR #458 and merge (EOD), 2) Sanjay finalize schema PR 712 with `account_id_hash` and `customer_tier` (EOW), 3) Lucy schedule backfill Fri 02:00 PT and confirm ops-review unblock, 4) Leo/SRE to advise capacity plan for histogram writes before 20% ramp, 5) Elaine to validate cost calc against sample payloads after merge. Ping here as you hit any blockers. :thumbsup:
